statement: Complete classification of every good-place local single-cusp marked-depth section and every full-source fiber: eight ordinary cusp families have a unique full lift; the marked cusp has the exact product-valued central parameter, with full image exactly its zero value; every unramified class and full fiber are those of E68. The entire twisted marked-kernel cocycle set over each other cusp section is one point, with a unique conjugator.

notes: The filled group B is the actual eight-punctured elliptic curve; its ramified-source proof includes the exact characteristic cover and compact Jacobian map.

The actual affine permutation is T(g)=c_i^b b_i theta_Q(g), with b_i the projected tangential path cocycle. Its compact image is the actual Kummer cocycle of P_i-Q. No pure automorphism is substituted for this affine action.
A periodic left coset would give rational compatible division points of a nonzero3-torsion point over a finite residue field, which is impossible in its finite elliptic-curve group.

The first kernel coinvariant is the actual coset measure module; the central coinvariant is the alternating summand of the diagonal-orbit measure module. Both compact images are closed and all maps are specified.

The actual tame cocycle equations give a unique first-layer conjugator, followed by a unique central conjugator. This includes every nonunit inertia exponent and retains all nonlinear central action terms.
Full-source images and fibers use the literal quotient P->W, the preserved abelian inertia and the previously proved full cusp classification.
Every local class and fiber at places away from3 is settled; the wild place and global intrinsic compatibility remain unresolved in E23.

A independently audited the complete proof, exact maps and topology, then freshly ran copied code. The complete JSON is identical with no field omitted; all9 literal tangent checks and648 compact Kummer obstructions pass. The exact audit is retained in a_independent_audits.md and a_e71_audit.json.
